name: PlayStation 2 — held: LRPS2 verified, delivery undecided
blocked_reason: Catalog/delivery decision pending, not engineering: LRPS2 (libretro/ps2) is maintained, GPL-3.0-or-later, and reaches RENDERS on linux-x64 (docs/MATRIX.md, 2026-10-07). PS2 requires a user-supplied BIOS dump that the project can never ship or fetch, so the slot stays held until the user-BIOS delivery policy lands. This supersedes the earlier 'no shippable core' reason.
